title: Failed bolus error message when bolus was delivered
symptom: When giving a bolus via AAPS, the app reports 'Bolus reported an error' and shows bolus delivery failed, but the bolus is actually delivered by the pump. This occurs intermittently, and when using the bolus wizard, entered carbs are deleted while the delivered insulin gets logged.
evidence_quote: I gave my daughter 2.1u of insulin directly using AAPS and got the "Bolus reported an error" message (please see screenshot), but I know that the bolus was definitely delivered by the Combo pump
